payload.comment: Data audit is clean. All 11 deterministic checks pass (official split, train/val indices, labels, pixels, shapes, train-only statistics, train-validation disjointness). PathMNIST 9-class 28×28×3 RGB loaded at full official sizes (89996/10004/7180) with no subsampling. Archive MD5 and SHA256 verified and consistent; selected-index SHA256 hashes present for all three splits. Zero blank images, zero duplicate train samples, train-validation overlap = 0. Imbalance ratio 1.63× is modest; class proportions between train and val are nearly identical (max Δ ≈ 0.00004), confirming no split-level distribution mismatch. Normalization stats (z-score) are correctly derived from train only. The six augmentations in the representation plan (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) are all built-in primitives and do not require extension approval; the two pending extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) do not invalidate these primitives. Augmented train size 629,972 = 89,996 × 7 is arithmetically correct. Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) is from a different clinical center; this is properly flagged and OOD AUROC aggregates should be interpreted as cross-center domain shift. Minor non-blocking note: llm_model_digest is null in the run manifest despite llm_model='qwen3.8'; populate before training/evaluation stages for full reproducibility of any LLM-in-the-loop decisions. No deterministic findings; no action-blocking issues. Proceed to next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null in run_manifest despite llm_model='qwen3.8' specified; populate before training/evaluation stages for full reproducibility of LLM-in-the-loop decisions
Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center; OOD AUROC aggregates must be interpreted as cross-center domain shift, not in-distribution performance

Two extension proposals (hflip_pathology_safe, compact_conv_token_transformer) remain in pending_review status; they do not block the current built-in augmentation plan but should be resolved before any architecture changes are applied
